subject.title: feat(android): add Wear conversations, voice, agents, and sessions

question: Should OpenClaw land the small status-only Wear foundation first, or sponsor this full conversation, voice, agent, and session surface as the initial Wear product?
rationale: Both approaches are technically plausible, but choosing the initial supported Wear scope, release commitment, and review sequence is a product decision that the contributor cannot settle through implementation alone.

options.title: Stage status first
options.body: Land or finish https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108803 first, then rebase and review conversation and voice as a narrower follow-up with complete release wiring.

options.title: Sponsor full Wear surface
options.body: Approve the broader product scope now, then require the versioning, packaging, naming, and failing-check repairs before merge.

options.title: Pause the full companion
options.body: Keep only the smaller foundation or pause Wear support until Android release ownership and maintenance capacity are established.

recommendation.title: Stage status first
recommendation.body: Land or finish https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108803 first, then rebase and review conversation and voice as a narrower follow-up with complete release wiring.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository identifies this person as the Android app owner, and the choice directly affects Android product scope and release packaging.
